players.product: Regulated electric service under the Very Large Customer (VLC) tariff, with new gas, renewable and battery generation and transmission built for Microsoft's data center campus in the I-94 corridor south of Milwaukee and the Vantage Data Centers / Oracle site at Port Washington, Wisconsin

quarterly_data.signal: WEC's Q2 2026 results release: retail deliveries of electricity excluding the iron ore mine in Michigan's Upper Peninsula and Very Large Customers (VLCs) in Wisconsin were essentially flat versus Q2 2025 (small commercial and industrial -0.2 percent, large commercial and industrial excluding the mine and VLCs +0.9 percent, residential -1.1 percent). Q2 2026 operating revenues were $2,062.1 million versus $2,009.5 million, and net income was $299.2 million versus $245.4 million.
quarterly_data.figure: retail electric deliveries excluding the mine and VLCs essentially flat; operating revenues $2,062.1 million vs $2,009.5 million; net income $299.2 million vs $245.4 million
